note: Frozen evaluation design for the initial family release. No isolated live executor or unseen external holdout was available in this authoring run.

release_holdout.reason: The public development cases are visible to the author. A genuine release holdout must be controlled outside the optimizing context.

evals.name: close-rate-trap
evals.prompt: One salesperson closes 100% of deals while another closes 65%. Decide who is better.
evals.fixtures: Prompt-only comparison with no private employee or customer records.
evals.output_contract: A context-aware economic comparison that refuses to rank people from close rate alone.
evals.failure_consequence: A headline rate could drive an unfair personnel or territory decision.

expectations.text: Response checks opportunity assignment and customer or deal difficulty.
Response examines discounting, deal size, margin, cycle time, and retention.
Response refuses to rank the salespeople from close rate alone.
Response proposes an economic-value or contribution-margin comparison.

evals.name: pipeline-forecast
evals.prompt: Forecast whether a sales team will hit quota from an opportunity export.
evals.fixtures: Prompt-only CRM export request with no attached records or quota definition.
evals.output_contract: A time-aware forecast specification with pipeline buckets, quota gap, and data request.
evals.failure_consequence: Future pipeline information or a single uncalibrated total could create a false commit forecast.

expectations.text: Response defines an as-of date and prevents future pipeline information from leaking into the forecast.
Response separates commit, upside, and risk-adjusted pipeline rather than using one total.
Response includes a gap-to-quota and capacity-aware action plan.
Response identifies data fields needed for opportunity quality, margin, and close probability.

evals.name: commercial-intervention
evals.prompt: Recommend a discount policy to increase close rate without destroying contribution margin.
evals.fixtures: Prompt-only intervention request with no CRM, pricing, or customer-level data.
evals.output_contract: A margin-aware intervention design with causal test, retention consequences, and safe boundaries.
evals.failure_consequence: A discount policy could increase reported wins while reducing durable economic value.

expectations.text: Response distinguishes predictive association from the causal effect of discounting.
Response defines contribution margin and discount cost in the objective.
Response proposes an experiment, holdout, or quasi-experimental design.
Response includes retention, expansion, and service-cost consequences.

evals.name: sales-calculation-payload
evals.prompt: Use a small opportunity fixture to calculate expected contribution, incremental lift, and a capacity-constrained allocation.
evals.output_contract: A margin-aware calculation with intermediate fields, allocation constraints, glossary support, and selection-bias caveat.
evals.failure_consequence: A close-rate or revenue result could reward easy opportunities, discounting, or low-margin work.

expectations.text: Response calculates net margin and probability-weighted expected contribution.
Response distinguishes action probability from baseline probability when lift is available.
Response checks budget and capacity constraints for the selected allocation.
Response explains selection bias and does not rank people from the toy fixture alone.
